caption: The drawing depicts a single stoneware crock or jar, which is beige-gray in color with slight variations in shading. The jar is cylindrical, widening toward the middle, and has a thick, rounded rim at the top. Two small, curved handles are attached symmetrically to either side near the upper portion. On the upper front section, the words “J. Norton & Co. Bennington, VT” are inscribed in small, uppercase letters. Below the inscription, in the center of the crock, there is a blue decorative design showing a stylized bird with a prominent tail and crest, facing to the right. The background is a blank off-white or light beige, and there are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the image. The artist’s signature, “N. Amantea,” is visible in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
